title: Episode 1: Introduction - The Mechanical Universe
summary: The first episode of Caltech's The Mechanical Universe, a 52-part introductory university physics series. David Goodstein introduces ideas from Copernicus to Newton, linking the physics of the heavens and the earth with computer animation.
why: HN rates the series as one of the best physics lecture courses on YouTube, with an engaging format and historical context.

quote.text: Hands down best: David Goodstein, CalTech,
